title: GrocLM：基于大语言模型的电商杂货品类推荐
summary: GrocLM 是一种针对电商杂货品类推荐微调的语言模型，采用两阶段 LoRA 训练策略编码周期性购买模式，并通过基于 Trie 的约束解码确保输出有效。在真实生产环境中，相比基线模型，其每次展示的加购数相对提升 7.5%。
summary_en: GrocLM is a fine-tuned language model for grocery category recommendation in e-commerce, using two-stage LoRA training to encode cyclical purchasing patterns and trie-based constrained decoding for valid outputs. It achieves a 7.5% relative improvement in cart-adds per impression in a live production restocking task.
